aggressive_definition: Tumors with Gleason score greater than 6 or higher clinical stage cT2b-cT4.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Risk according to tumor aggressiveness (Gleason score 6 vs greater than 6) and extension (cT1-cT2a vs cT2b-cT4) was evaluated by multinomial regression models.
reason: The study assessed prostate cancer risk generally and stratified incident cases by tumor aggressiveness and extension. It explicitly reports estimates for Gleason score greater than 6 and clinical stage cT2b-cT4. The abstract gives separate case and control counts but no directly stated total analytic N.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: High adherence to a Mediterranean dietary pattern rich not only in fruits and vegetables but also in fish, legumes and olive oil was specifically associated with a lower risk of Gleason score greater than 6 prostate cancer (quartile 3 vs 1 relative RR 0.66, 95% CI 0.46-0.96 and quartile 4 vs 1 relative RR 0.68, 95% CI 0.46-1.01, p-trend = 0.023) or with higher clinical stage (cT2b-T4 quartile 4 vs 1 relative RR 0.49, 95% CI 0.25-0.96, p-trend = 0.024).
estimate_classifications.reason: The row's quartile 4 versus quartile 1 estimate is explicitly for incident prostate cancer with Gleason score greater than 6, an aggressive endpoint.
